composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component. Raw inputs may omit lag or contain any JSON value; accept exact integers -1..8 inclusive (not bool/float); always result={accepted:boolean,lag:original if accepted else null}; invalid/missing return false/null without exceptions or coercion. The helper receives the whole mapping so absence and explicit null are distinguished; it is invoked at module scope and its returned object is assigned to result. No imports/I/O/host calls. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation was performed.
